title: SiteApprovalChanged
description:
Payload of `platform.site_approval.changed.v1`: the owner approved or withdrew the manifest of
one site.

A fact. Platform writes it with the row of `identity.site_approvals` in one transaction, once
per change, and `ratatoskr-sites` keeps a read projection of it (workspace spec
`site-manifest`). A withdrawal repeats the digest, the capabilities and the hostname of the
approval it ends. The enclosing envelope carries the owner as `tenant_id` and the aggregate
`site:<site_id>`.

`Deserialize` is hand-written because `capabilities` must hold each capability once.

capabilities.description: The capabilities of the approved manifest, each once.

hostname.description: The hostname of the approved manifest.

manifest_sha256.description: The lowercase hex SHA-256 of the manifest bytes that the approval names.

state.description: Whether the approval is now in force.

oneOf.description: The owner approved the manifest digest; it is the approved manifest of the site.
The owner withdrew the approval; the site serves nothing.

DigestHex.title: DigestHex
DigestHex.description: Lowercase hexadecimal bytes of a content digest.

Hostname.title: Hostname
Hostname.description:
The DNS hostname that serves a site, in lower case, without a scheme, a port or a final dot.

Two or more labels separated by `.`; each label has 1 to 63 lower-case ASCII letters,
digits and `-`, and does not start or end with `-`. At most 253 characters.

SiteCapability.description:
One capability that a site manifest can request.

**Closed on purpose** (workspace spec `site-manifest`, "Capabilities are a closed set with a
fixed audience"): a manifest that names any other value is refused. The first four are
available to an anonymous visitor; the other four only to a `site_owner` session.

oneOf.description: Read the pages and the navigation of the current release. Anyone.
Read the assets of the current release. Anyone.
Full-text search over the current release only. Anyone.
Read unpublished changes of the site's publications. Owner session only.
Write the source notes of the site's publications. Owner session only.
Read the owner's knowledge library. Owner session only.
Search across the owner's knowledge, not only the publication. Owner session only.

SiteId.title: SiteId
SiteId.description:
The id of one site: 3 to 40 lower-case ASCII letters, digits and `-`.

The grammar is the `site:<site id>` form of `WriteOrigin` in `ratatoskr-notes-contracts`.
The owner chooses the id, and it appears in every route under `/v1/sites/{site}/`.
